items.html:
The faint quadrupole is physically expected at that setting; the display context is misleading.

Setting Total Q Dipole Q Quadrupole Q
Screenshot: R0.23, λ1.45μm 7.91868 7.91153 0.00714 (0.090%)
Quadrupole resonance: R0.30, λ1.31μm 6.87080 2.34791 4.52239 (65.82%)

At the screenshot setting, median quadrupole |Ez|≈0.0051; the fixed rendering scale produces under1% colour contrast. At the stronger setting it is0.186. For radius0.23, the strong quadrupole resonance falls outside the supported wavelength range.

Minimal honest improvement:

  • Make the prominent score and spectrum follow the selected multipole. Currently both show all-order scattering, while the clarifying percentage disappears on mobile.
  • Provide an explicit strong-quadrupole preset at R0.30, λ1.31μm, without silently changing parameters when selecting a filter.
  • If adding display amplification, label its gain; preserve numerical values and avoid quietly normalizing weak modes into apparent strong scattering.

Useful regression in existing check.mjs: verify sum(result.orders)≈result.score, screenshot quadrupole fraction below0.1%, and the explicit resonant preset above60%. The current WASM satisfies these; order-sum error is5.3e−15.

Read-only investigation; no edits.
